boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented no-cost activities for Monmouth students, plus free nearby historic-site visits.

cards.title: Train at the OceanFirst Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: OceanFirst Bank Center, Monmouth University
cards.notes: Bring your Monmouth ID and use the fitness center for a shared workout or an independent strength and cardio session.
cards.short_summary: A campus-ID fitness session with no added charge.
cards.evidence_claim: Monmouth states that every student can participate in athletic or recreational activities for free with a campus ID, including at the OceanFirst Bank Center.
cards.source_title: Health & Wellness | Residential Life | Monmouth University
cards.access_notes: For Monmouth students; show campus ID. Use the facility according to current recreation access rules.

cards.title: Rally at the Tennis Complex
cards.subtitle: North Campus, Monmouth University
cards.notes: Meet with a partner for a tennis session; bring racquets and balls if needed, then follow posted court-use guidance.
cards.short_summary: Campus tennis is included in free student recreation access.
cards.evidence_claim: Monmouth lists the Tennis Complex among facilities available to students for free with campus ID.
cards.source_title: Health & Wellness | Residential Life | Monmouth University
cards.access_notes: For Monmouth students; show campus ID and confirm court availability before playing.

cards.title: Bowl at Ciniello Family Bowling Center
cards.subtitle: Boylan Gymnasium, Monmouth University
cards.notes: Plan a low-key game with classmates at the campus bowling center and check in with recreation staff for current lane access.
cards.short_summary: A student-access bowling activity without an added fee.
cards.evidence_claim: Monmouth lists the Ciniello Family Bowling Center among facilities available to students for free with campus ID.
cards.source_title: Health & Wellness | Residential Life | Monmouth University
cards.access_notes: For Monmouth students; show campus ID and ask recreation staff about open lanes and equipment.

cards.title: Swim at Steadman Natatorium
cards.subtitle: Boylan Gymnasium, Monmouth University
cards.notes: Use a scheduled open-swim window for laps or a relaxed swim with friends; follow current pool and lifeguard procedures.
cards.short_summary: Campus pool access is part of free student recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: Monmouth lists the Steadman Natatorium-Pool among facilities available to students for free with campus ID.
cards.source_title: Health & Wellness | Residential Life | Monmouth University
cards.access_notes: For Monmouth students; show campus ID and use only during posted recreation or open-swim times.

cards.title: Play a Court Game at Boylan
cards.subtitle: Boylan Gymnasium, Monmouth University
cards.notes: Coordinate a basketball, volleyball, pickleball, or badminton session and confirm which courts are available before starting.
cards.short_summary: An adaptable indoor recreation option for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Monmouth lists Boylan Gymnasium among facilities available to students for free with campus ID and identifies courts for basketball, volleyball, pickleball, and badminton.
cards.source_title: Health & Wellness | Residential Life | Monmouth University
cards.access_notes: For Monmouth students; show campus ID and check current court scheduling with recreation staff.

cards.title: Watch a Hawks Competition
cards.subtitle: Monmouth University athletic venues
cards.notes: Choose a scheduled varsity contest and attend as a student spectator; check the athletics calendar and venue instructions first.
cards.short_summary: Student spectators can attend varsity competition without admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Monmouth states that all athletic competitions are free to student spectators.
cards.source_title: Campus Services | Student Handbook | Monmouth University
cards.access_notes: Free for Monmouth student spectators; verify the event schedule and any ticketing instructions before attending.

cards.title: Tour the Historic Racing Stable
cards.subtitle: Thompson Park, Lincroft
cards.notes: Visit during the listed seasonal Friday-through-Sunday hours to see exhibits about Brookdale Farm’s thoroughbred-racing history.
cards.short_summary: A free historic-stable visit with interpretive exhibits.
cards.evidence_claim: The Monmouth County Park System says admission to the Historic Racing Stable is free and no reservation is required.
cards.source_title: Historic Racing Stable | Monmouth County Park System
cards.access_notes: Seasonal site; confirm current tour days and weather status before traveling. No reservation is required.

cards.title: Walk Through Longstreet Farm
cards.subtitle: Holmdel Park, Holmdel
cards.notes: Explore the living historical farm at your own pace, then check the official page for farmhouse hours and program details.
cards.short_summary: A self-paced visit to a county living-history farm.
cards.evidence_claim: The Monmouth County Park System states that visitors may enter Longstreet Farm at their leisure, free of charge.
cards.source_title: Historic Sites | Monmouth County Park System
cards.access_notes: Open daily year-round; the official page lists seasonal farm and farmhouse hours. Groups require a confirmed reservation.

cards.title: Join a Portland Place House Tour
cards.subtitle: Hartshorne Woods Park, Locust
cards.notes: Sign up at the Visitor Center on the day of your visit for a docent-led look at the historic house and its artwork.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission guided-house option in Hartshorne Woods.
cards.evidence_claim: The Monmouth County Park System states that docent-led Historic Portland Place tours have free admission.
cards.source_title: Historic Portland Place | Monmouth County Park System
cards.access_notes: Tours are seasonal, Wednesday-Sunday, with same-day sign-up at the Visitor Center and a 10-person limit per tour.

cards.title: Settle Into Guggenheim Memorial Library
cards.subtitle: Monmouth University
cards.notes: Use the library’s study and research setting with classmates, and consult the current hours page before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A campus study gathering anchored by library resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Monmouth describes Guggenheim Memorial Library as providing Monmouth students access to online databases, e-journals, e-books, and research materials.
cards.source_title: University Librarian’s Welcome | Guggenheim Memorial Library
cards.access_notes: Library access and services are for Monmouth students; check current building hours and campus-ID requirements.
